name: qsmxt-bids
label: QSMxT
description: Runs Neurodesk QSMxT on an XNAT MR session. The session's DICOM scans are mounted directly and QSMxT converts them to BIDS internally (dicom-sort + dicom-convert) before running the QSM pipeline, so no pre-existing NIFTI or BIDS scan resources are required.
command-line: bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail; case "$QSMXT_PREMADE" in default|gre|epi|bet|fast|body|nextqsm) ;; *) echo "Invalid QSMxT premade pipeline: $QSMXT_PREMADE" >&2; exit 2;; esac; mkdir -p /work/home /work/matplotlib /work/sorted /work/bids /output; echo "Sorting DICOMs..."; python -c "from qsmxt.cli.dicom_sort import main; main()" /input /work/sorted; echo "Converting DICOMs to BIDS..."; dicom-convert /work/sorted /work/bids --auto_yes; args=(/work/bids --premade "$QSMXT_PREMADE" --do_qsm --auto_yes); case "$QSMXT_DO_SEGMENTATION" in true) args+=(--do_segmentation);; false) ;; *) echo "Invalid QSMxT segmentation flag: $QSMXT_DO_SEGMENTATION" >&2; exit 2;; esac; case "$QSMXT_DO_ANALYSIS" in true) args+=(--do_analysis);; false) ;; *) echo "Invalid QSMxT analysis flag: $QSMXT_DO_ANALYSIS" >&2; exit 2;; esac; echo "Running QSMxT..."; qsmxt "${args[@]}"; if [ ! -d /work/bids/derivatives ]; then echo "QSMxT produced no derivatives directory (no QSM-compatible series found?)" >&2; exit 3; fi; cp -a /work/bids/derivatives/. /output/'

inputs.name: premade
inputs.label: Premade pipeline
inputs.description: QSMxT premade pipeline. Supported values: default, gre, epi, bet, fast, body, nextqsm.

inputs.name: do-segmentation
inputs.label: Segmentation
inputs.description: Run QSMxT segmentation outputs in addition to QSM reconstruction.

inputs.name: do-analysis
inputs.label: Analysis CSVs
inputs.description: Run QSMxT analysis export. Usually enable segmentation as well.

outputs.name: qsmxt-output
outputs.description: QSMxT derivatives copied from the BIDS derivatives directory.

xnat.name: qsmxt-session
xnat.label: QSMxT
xnat.description: Run QSMxT on this MR session

external-inputs.name: session
external-inputs.description: Input MR session. Its DICOM scans are converted to BIDS inside the QSMxT container, so no pre-existing NIFTI/BIDS scan resources are needed. The session should contain multi-echo GRE (part-mag/part-phase) QSM series.
